## User problem

Who is trying to do what, and what currently gets in the way?

## Proposed experience

Describe the smallest useful workflow. Identify the affected project or service and any simpler alternative.

## Acceptance criteria

What observable behavior and tests would show that this is working? Distinguish code completion, deployment, and real user/host acceptance where relevant.

## Boundaries

Note any new hosting costs, model usage, permissions, external data, account state, or changes to existing saves. State what should remain out of scope.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/Ballzatram/ballzatram/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) for project expectations.
